name: term-sheet-structure
description: 7-subsection term-sheet norm (partnerships-bd methodology, phase 2 only). use_when: the partnerships-bd phase-2 record's term-sheet-outline field is about to be written. Emits all 7 named sub-sections in order; exit/termination is non-optional and governance/KPIs are kept distinct. term-sheet-outline is a phase-2-record-only field; no phase-1 proposal carries a term sheet.
